title: Crownlands - Development Progress & What to Expect
author: Crownlands_dev
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’d like to introduce you to my game, Crownlands — an open-world RPG.

I wanted to share some of the mechanics I’ve already implemented and give you an idea of what to expect from the game, although this is still nowhere near what I have planned for the final version. 😄

Since I’m developing the game entirely on my own, I use quite a lot of AI tools that help me a lot during development. Of course, I still have to manually work on and refine many of the elements, but that’s just part of the process.

For coding, I use Claude Code.

For brainstorming and consultations, I use ChatGPT.

For 3D modeling, I use Meshy AI.

I’d really love to hear your thoughts and feedback on what I’ve been working on, as well as any suggestions you might have. 🤗
